0022600160.text: The Atlanta Hawks (3-4, 1-2 at home, 2-2 on the road) visit the Indiana Pacers (2-4, 0-2 at home) for the Hawks' eighth game of the 2026-27 season. Atlanta, which lost its most recent game, is 2nd in the Southeast and half a game back, while Indiana, on a three-game losing streak, is 3rd in the Central and 12th in the East. Atlanta is without Henri Veesaar (knee), Jock Landale (hip), Mouhamed Gueye (foot fracture) and Jalen Johnson (ankle, day-to-day with a game-time decision), and Indiana is without Ben Sheppard (knee), Ivica Zubac (ankle sprain), Johnny Furphy (knee surgery), T.J. McConnell (hamstring strain) and Tyrese Haliburton (hamstring strain). The teams have not met yet in 2026-27, but the Hawks won the 2025-26 season series 2-1, and their last meeting was on January 31 in Indianapolis, where Atlanta lost 129-124.
